diagram_title: Parse Gerber Copper Geometry And Answer Deterministic Clearance Queries

activities.title: Parse Copper Layer Into Draw Events
activities.description: Consume the already-parsed gerber copper layer artifact (parse_gerber_file draw/flash/region events plus aperture table) and normalize it into ordered geometry draw events; fail fast when the layer is missing or yields zero D01/D03 geometry.

activities.title: Build Net-Attributed Geometry Primitives
activities.description: Materialize draw events into computable primitives (polygon / track / pad / plane) with coordinates and connected-copper-island net attribution; mark arc/circle/curve primitives as curve and keep them out of linear distance math.

activities.title: Answer Copper Geometry Query
activities.description: Compute the requested deterministic geometry query (edge-to-edge copper spacing, point-to-copper distance, plane coverage) over the primitive set and return the distance value with geometry provenance and skipped-curve disclosure.
